_comment: Provenance pin for the plant in this directory. scripts/check_model_identity.py refuses to train when the XML hash or any number below disagrees with the compiled training model. Written 2026-09-10 when the 0910 delivery replaced the 0908 file.

wheel.model: DM3519 + replacement 15.8:1 gearbox, 0.90 relative efficiency assumed
wheel.status: envelope is a linear estimate scaled from the stock 19.2032:1 catalogue points; efficiency, rotor inertia and thermal limits are unmeasured

gas_spring.status: selected nominal spec; fast-compression, temperature and friction need hardware calibration

unchanged_by_0910: collision geometry (24 collision geoms, byte-for-byte identical to 0908)
250 mm tunnel clearance conflict (visual CAD top 273.0 mm vs simulated collision top 235.3 mm)
closed-chain topology (nq 29 / nv 28 / neq 10 / nu 6) and solver options
asset_note: all 108 assets/*.stl are byte-identical between the 0908 and 0910 packages; robot_hifi.xml is the only file that changes
